name: Date Type 9 Code
definition: Date is specified as a fixed code value.

PWAL.name: Blocking Till End Of Election Period
PWAL.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the end of the election period of the option.

MKDT.name: Blocking Till Market Deadline
MKDT.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the market deadline of the option.

MEET.name: Blocking Till Meeting Date
MEET.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the meeting date.

PAYD.name: Blocking Till Payment Date
PAYD.definition: Unblocking will occur on payment date of the option.

RDTE.name: Blocking Till Record Date
RDTE.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the record date of the event.

RDDT.name: Blocking Till Response Deadline
RDDT.definition: Blocking occurs until and inclusive of the account servicer deadline for the option.

NARR.name: Narrative Unblocking Date
NARR.definition: Refer to additional information element for the date until when the securities are blocked.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Date is unknown by the sender or has not been established.
